Description: Local non-cash definitions. Prices, schedules, pity and missing pet rules are configurable approximations, not recovered live-server rules. Begin/End use UTC Unix seconds; zero is unbounded.

Festivals.Description: Local annual schedule from docs/proposed-event-calendar.md, in UTC. Annual ranges are inclusive MM-DD days and an end before its start runs into the next year; Monthly Days are an inclusive day range; Weekly runs Days days from each From weekday. Nodes are hidden chapter-99 world-map nodes, Shops map native EventShop condition codes to ShopTable indices (0 opens only the client condition). ExpireCurrencies and ExpireItems are cleared when the last overlapping festival using them closes. Around runs Before..After days around each listed date (holidays that move, such as Lunar New Year; extend Dates for later years). Gifts mail the Daily item on each day of a run an account logs in and the Final item once after Days such days. Shops SprkWorldBossChristmas and SprkWorldBossMoonRabbit only signal the client to show the Protianus and Mountain Fortress World Bosses in their event forms (SprkWorldBossSkin). Bosses would schedule a standalone event boss; none has a client entry. GM overrides: python server/gm.py festival.
